title: The Last Photograph
summary: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae return to the abandoned Kang family apartment in Seoul. In Tae-Jun's old desk, Ha-Jun uncovers a hidden photograph carrying an encrypted demonic cipher.

panels.shot: abandoned seoul apartment block at twilight wide shot
panels.action: A faded 1990s red-brick apartment complex stands quiet under an amber and purple twilight sky.
panels.prose_en: A faded 1990s red-brick apartment complex stands quiet under an amber and purple twilight sky.
panels.prose_hi: 1990 ke dashak ka feeka lal-int wala apartment parisar amber aur baingani godhuli aakash ke neeche shant khada hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing before rusted apartment door 402
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands in the dim hallway, his hand hesitating inches away from the peeling wooden door labeled 402.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Saat saal baad... Main wapas yahin khada hoon jahan sab kuch chhin gaya tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands in the dim hallway, his hand hesitating inches away from the peeling wooden door labeled 402.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun mand galiyare mein khada hai, uska haath 402 label wale chheelate lakdi ke darvaje se kuch inch ki doori par jhijhak raha hai.

panels.shot: min-jae placing reassuring hand on ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Min-Jae gently rests his hand on Ha-Jun's shoulder: 'We are with you, bro. Take your time.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun, relax. Hum dono tumhare peeche hain.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae gently rests his hand on Ha-Jun's shoulder: 'We are with you, bro. Take your time.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne dheere se Ha-Jun ke kandhe par apna haath rakha: 'ham tumhare saath han, bhai. paryapt samay lo.'.

panels.shot: kuro perching on the banister eyeing the locks
panels.action: Kuro tilts his raven head, his ruby eyes glinting in the dark: 'A faint blood ward still lingers on this threshold.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh lock simple metal nahi hai. Ispe Tae-Jun ka blood-barrier laga tha.

panels.prose_en: Kuro tilts his raven head, his ruby eyes glinting in the dark: 'A faint blood ward still lingers on this threshold.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apna kaua sir jhukata hai, uski lal aankhen andhere mein chamakti han: 'ek behosh khoon ka ward abhi bhi is dahalij par maujood hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun touching door handle with glowing violet finger
panels.action: A tiny spark of Ha-Jun's violet mana touches the rusted brass lock; the ancient blood seal recognizes him and dissolves.
panels.prose_en: A tiny spark of Ha-Jun's violet mana touches the rusted brass lock; the ancient blood seal recognizes him and dissolves.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke baingani man ki ek chhoti si chingari zang lage pital ke taale ko chhuti hai; prachin khoon seal use pehchan leti hai aur ghul jaati hai.

panels.shot: door swinging open into dusty apartment interior
panels.action: The door groans inward, revealing dust motes floating in sunbeams across a frozen-in-time living room.
panels.prose_en: The door groans inward, revealing dust motes floating in sunbeams across a frozen-in-time living room.
panels.prose_hi: Darwaza andar ki or karahata hai, jisse kamre mein jame hue samay mein dhoop ki kiranon mein dhul ke kan tairte hue dikhai dete han.

panels.shot: living room frozen in time with covered furniture
panels.action: White dust sheets drape over sofas; an old tube television and yellowed family calendar still hang on the wall.
panels.prose_en: White dust sheets drape over sofas; an old tube television and yellowed family calendar still hang on the wall.
panels.prose_hi: Sophon par safed dhul ki chadren bichhi hui han; ek purana tube television aur peela parivarik calendar abhi bhi deewar par tanga hua hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking down narrow hallway toward tae-jun room
panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly walks past cracked family portraits, his boots leaving clean footprints in the thick grey dust.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slowly walks past cracked family portraits, his boots leaving clean footprints in the thick grey dust.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhire-dhire toote hue parivarik chitron ke peeche chalta hai, uske jute ghani bhuri dhul mein saaf pairon ke nishan chhod rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning the knob of tae-jun bedroom door
panels.action: The door marked with a peeling soccer sticker opens into his elder brother's private sanctum.
panels.prose_en: The door marked with a peeling soccer sticker opens into his elder brother's private sanctum.
panels.prose_hi: Football ke chhilate sticker wala darwaza unke bade bhai ke niji garbhgrih mein khulta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun dusty bedroom interior wide shot
panels.action: Bookshelves filled with engineering texts, a study desk covered in notebooks, and a guitar case in the corner.
panels.prose_en: Bookshelves filled with engineering texts, a study desk covered in notebooks, and a guitar case in the corner.
panels.prose_hi: Engineering granthon se bhari kitabon ki almariyan, notebooks se dhaka ek adhyayan desk aur kone mein ek guitar kes.

panels.shot: ha-jun gently touching tae-jun study desk surface
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the worn wooden desk edge where Tae-Jun used to help him with elementary math homework.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung yahin baith kar ghanton padhta tha... Taaki mujhe achha school mil sake.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches the worn wooden desk edge where Tae-Jun used to help him with elementary math homework.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun us ghise-pite lakdi ke desk kinare ko chhuta hai jahan Tae-Jun prathmik ganit ke homework mein uski madad karta tha.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto the desk tapping wood with beak
panels.action: Kuro taps his obsidian beak against the left drawer cavity: 'Look beneath the bottom panel, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Wood ke andar hollow space hai. Demonic seal detected.

panels.prose_en: Kuro taps his obsidian beak against the left drawer cavity: 'Look beneath the bottom panel, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apni obsidian chonch ko bai daraaj ki guha par thapthapata hai: 'nichale panel ke neeche dekho, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling out bottom drawer finding secret latch
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides out the bottom drawer; feeling along the rear mahogany grain, he clicks a spring-loaded latch.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides out the bottom drawer; feeling along the rear mahogany grain, he clicks a spring-loaded latch.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun neeche ki daraaj se bahar nikalta hai; peeche ke mahogani daane ko mahsoos karte hue, wah spring-loded kundi ko click karta hai.

panels.shot: false bottom popping open revealing hidden metal box
panels.action: A secret false bottom tilts open, exposing a velvet-lined lead box sealed with silver wire.
panels.prose_en: A secret false bottom tilts open, exposing a velvet-lined lead box sealed with silver wire.
panels.prose_hi: Ek gupt jhutha tal khulta hai, jo chandi ke taar se seal kiye gaye makhamli-rekha wale sise ke bakse ko ujagar karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun lifting out old analogue photograph
panels.action: Inside lies an old glossy photograph, an encrypted optical mini-disc, and a silver hunter dog-tag.
panels.prose_en: Inside lies an old glossy photograph, an encrypted optical mini-disc, and a silver hunter dog-tag.
panels.prose_hi: Ander ek purani chamakdar tasweer, ek encrypted optical mini-disk aur ek chandi ka shikari kutta-tag hai.

panels.shot: extreme macro on photograph: namsan tower childhood
panels.action: The photograph shows 7-year-old Ha-Jun eating ice cream while 12-year-old Tae-Jun ruffles his hair with a big brotherly grin.

dialogue.text: Wo aakhri summer vacation... Jab sab kuch theek tha.

panels.prose_en: The photograph shows 7-year-old Ha-Jun eating ice cream while 12-year-old Tae-Jun ruffles his hair with a big brotherly grin.
panels.prose_hi: Tasveer mein 7 varshiya Ha-Jun ko icecream khate hue dikhaya gaya hai, jabki 12 varshiya Tae-Jun bade bhai jaisi muskan ke saath apne baalon ko sahala raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes widening as he spots anomaly in photo
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes narrow as he notices the observation deck reflection behind them in the glass.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wait... Yeh background window mein reflection kiski hai?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes narrow as he notices the observation deck reflection behind them in the glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen sankirna ho gai kyonki usne kaanch mein apne peeche avlokan deck ka chhaya dekha.

panels.shot: macro on background glass reflection in photo
panels.action: Reflected in the glass twenty feet behind the boys: a tall man in a black trench coat with burning crimson eyes watching them.
panels.prose_en: Reflected in the glass twenty feet behind the boys: a tall man in a black trench coat with burning crimson eyes watching them.
panels.prose_hi: Ladkon ke bees feet peeche sheeshe mein pratibimbit hua: kale trench coat mein ek lamba aadmi aur jalti hui lal aankhen unhen dekh rahi thin.

panels.shot: kuro flaming ruby eye inspecting the photograph
panels.action: Kuro breathes a wisp of purple hellfire across the photograph's surface without burning the paper.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Paper fiber mein microscopic blood runes hain. Tae-Jun left a message.

panels.prose_en: Kuro breathes a wisp of purple hellfire across the photograph's surface without burning the paper.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro kagaj ko jalaye bina tasveer ki satah par baingani narkankaal ki saans chhodta hai.

panels.shot: glowing violet runes appearing on photo back
panels.action: Written in glowing purple blood ink on the back: 'Project Chimera. Section 9 Vault 7. Don't trust Chairman Song.'
panels.prose_en: Written in glowing purple blood ink on the back: 'Project Chimera. Section 9 Vault 7. Don't trust Chairman Song.'.
panels.prose_hi: Pith par chamakti baingani khoon syahi se likha: 'project chimera. dhara 9 walt 7. chairman song par bharosa na karen.'

panels.shot: ha-jun clutching photo with trembling fingers
panels.action: Ha-Jun grips the photo; his knuckles turn white as memories of that summer flash with new dark meaning.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun ko shuru se pata tha... Hum pe saalon se nazar rakhi ja rahi thi!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grips the photo; his knuckles turn white as memories of that summer flash with new dark meaning.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne photo pakad li; jaise hi us garmi ki yaadein naye gahre arth ke saath chamakti han, uske por safed ho jaate han.

panels.shot: min-jae leaning over shoulder looking stunned
panels.action: Min-Jae gasps: 'Section 9 Vault 7? That was the classified deep bio-research wing shut down five years ago!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Vault 7?! Mere father Section 9 records mein kehte the wo lab illegal thi!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae gasps: 'Section 9 Vault 7? That was the classified deep bio-research wing shut down five years ago!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je haanfte hue kahte han: 'dhara 9 walt 7? wah vargikrit gahan jaiv-anusandhan wing tha jise paanch saal pehle band kar diya gaya tha!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun picking up the optical mini-disc
panels.action: Ha-Jun lifts the heavy metallic optical disc; its surface is etched with micro-circuits and demonic sigils.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lifts the heavy metallic optical disc; its surface is etched with micro-circuits and demonic sigils.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bhari dhatvik optical disk uthata hai; iski satah sukshm-sarkit aur shaitani demonic sigil se ukeri gai hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating the eye of the night relic
panels.action: Ha-Jun's right iris shifts into the radiant golden pupil of the Eye of the Night.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's right iris shifts into the radiant golden pupil of the Eye of the Night.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki dahini paritarika raat ki aankh ki chamakdar sunhari putli mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: optical disc projecting holographic particles into bedroom
panels.action: The disc responds to his demonic mana, projecting floating crimson-cyan volumetric light particles into the room.
panels.prose_en: The disc responds to his demonic mana, projecting floating crimson-cyan volumetric light particles into the room.
panels.prose_hi: Disk uske shaitani demonic man par pratikriya karti hai, kamre mein tairte hue crimson-siyan volumetric prakash kanon ko prakshepit karti hai.

panels.shot: distorted holographic silhouette forming in center
panels.action: Static and digital scanlines resolve into the life-sized three-dimensional projection of a young man.
panels.prose_en: Static and digital scanlines resolve into the life-sized three-dimensional projection of a young man.
panels.prose_hi: Sthaitik aur digital scanlinen ek yuva vyakti ke jivan-aakar ke tri-aayami prakshepan mein vilin ho jaati han.

panels.shot: tae-jun face crystallizing in the hologram
panels.action: A 15-year-old Kang Tae-Jun appears—wearing a battered leather jacket, bandaged hands, and tired, resolute eyes.
panels.prose_en: A 15-year-old Kang Tae-Jun appears—wearing a battered leather jacket, bandaged hands, and tired, resolute eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ek 15 varshiya kang Tae-Jun prakat hota hai - ek fata hua chamde ka jacket pahane hue, hathon par patti bandhi hui, aur thaki hui, dridh aankhen.

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram looking directly toward viewer
panels.action: The holographic recording speaks in a warm, steady voice: 'Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh dekh rahe ho...'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh dekh rahe ho, toh meri prediction sach ho chuki hai.

panels.prose_en: The holographic recording speaks in a warm, steady voice: 'Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh dekh rahe ho...'.
panels.prose_hi: Holographik recording garm, sthir awaz mein bolti hai: 'Ha-Jun... agar tum yeh dekh rahe ho...'.

panels.shot: ha-jun tears spilling as he stares at brother's image
panels.action: Tears stream down Ha-Jun's cheeks as he reaches out toward the flickering light, unable to touch him.
panels.prose_en: Tears stream down Ha-Jun's cheeks as he reaches out toward the flickering light, unable to touch him.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi Ha-Jun timtimati roshni ki or badhta hai, use chhune mein asamarth hota hai, Ha-Jun ke gaalon se aansu bahane lagte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram issuing grave warning cliffhanger
panels.action: Tae-Jun's holographic eyes turn deadly serious: 'Listen carefully. Our parents didn't die in an accident. They were hunted.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hamare parents kisi accident mein nahi mare. They were assassinated by Section 9.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's holographic eyes turn deadly serious: 'Listen carefully. Our parents didn't die in an accident. They were hunted.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki holographic aankhen ghatak roop se gambhir ho jaati han: 'dhyan se suno. hamare mata-pita kisi durghatna mein nahin mare. unka shikar kiya gaya.'
